messages:
maria: Quick async alignment on Dedicated capacity buildout — owners, blockers, and milestone confirmations. TL;DR: procurement ETA ~3/31–4/2, rack power nominal by 4/04, network + IPs by 4/06, aiming for H100 canary week of 4/07. Need owners for reservation, infra tickets, and smoke plan. @sam_irwin @li_wang @jess @ahmad @sre_oncall

sam_irwin: Procurement update — PO submitted yesterday. Vendor estimates ship window 2026-03-29 -> 2026-04-02. Waiting on final ship notice / AWB. No customs flags so far. Will share AWB when I get it.

li_wang: From model/ML side: we need 8 H100 nodes pinned for the canary run. Artifacts (quantized + weight-shard manifest) will be ready by 2026-03-30. Also need KV cache persistence test on the nodes. Please reserve nodes ASAP.

maria: Can someone own the reservation? We want a reservation window that gives us time to smoke + perf test before any public traffic. @ahmad?

ahmad: I can take reservation. Proposed window: 2026-04-07 00:00 -> 2026-04-14 23:59. Command I'll run: `capacity-tool reserve --pool dedicated-us-west-2-prod --count 8 --start 2026-04-07 --end 2026-04-14 --note "H100 canary - model validation"` Any objections to 4/07 start?

jess: SRE/infra side — network + storage checklist: need IP allocation, security group updates, and NFS (or NVMe) mount for model artifacts. I'll open an infra ticket for tracking. ETA for IP ranges expected by 2026-04-05.

sre_oncall: Heads up — deploy-bot currently has a capacity-cleanup job scheduled 2026-04-06 03:00 UTC that might evict reserved slots. If we keep 4/07 start, we should cancel that cleanup or ensure it skips reservations. @maria can you confirm?

deploy-bot: Automated notice: capacity-cleanup-job scheduled at 2026-04-06T03:00Z for pool: dedicated-us-west-2-prod. To cancel, run: `deploy-bot cancel capacity-cleanup-job --pool dedicated-us-west-2-prod`

maria: Pushing start to 4/07 makes sense. @sam_irwin please confirm vendor ship ETA so we know nodes will be in-region before reservation Active.

sam_irwin: Will confirm tomorrow and upload AWB. If vendor delays past 2026-04-02 we have a fallback plan: reserve spare nodes in us-east and run non-latency-sensitive stress tests there.

li_wang: Note — cross-region fallback is only acceptable for stress/workload tests. Canary for latency-sensitive verification must run in the target region.

ahmad: Reservation step complete (async): reservation-id rsv_20260407_001. I blocked 8 nodes in dedicated-us-west-2-prod for 2026-04-07 -> 2026-04-14. Current status: Pending until nodes physically present. Ran: `capacity-tool status rsv_20260407_001` — shows Pending. Will flip to Active when nodes appear.

maria: Great. @jess please drop the infra ticket number for IP/NFS/NVMe tracking when you have it.

jess: INFRA-7124 created: "NFS + IP allocation for H100 canary" assigned to @eng-infra. ETA 2026-04-05. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INFRA-7124

ahmad: One more infra note — kernel parameter tweak needed for iommu on these nodes; I'll escalate to driver team. CC @li_wang to validate perf impact.

li_wang: Acknowledged. Also requesting KV persistence enabled in runtime for the canary. Sample runtime fragment:

```
runtime:
  kv_cache:
    persist: true
    path: /mnt/nvme/kv-persist
  batch:
    max_tokens: 2048
```
Can infra guarantee NVMe mount for that path?

jess: Storage confirmed ephemeral NVMe on H100 nodes, will request mount in INFRA-7124.

sre_oncall: Please prepare a smoke canary checklist: smoke plan, load generators, perf metrics (p95 latency, tokens/sec, KV hit ratio), regression alerts and rollback criteria. I'll paste the checklist into the ticket later.

maria: Action items recap: sam — upload AWB and final ship ETA; ahmad — hold reservation (rsv_20260407_001) and flip Active when nodes present; jess — INFRA-7124 updates for IP/NVMe/NFS; li — artifacts + kv-persist config + perf validation; sre_oncall — smoke test plan and alert thresholds. Reconvene async on 2026-04-06 for final go/no-go. :calendar:

sam_irwin: :thumbsup: will post AWB when available, will ping procurement channel if any delays.

ahmad: :white_check_mark: reservation rsv_20260407_001 in place — I'll update when status changes to Active.

deploy-bot: Reminder: canary window reserved 2026-04-07 -> 2026-04-14 for rsv_20260407_001. Tagging reservation: `canary-h100`.
